evidence: Jetz & Pyron 2018 SI: 15 calibrations; the root (Amphibia-Amniota, 330.4-350.1 Ma, pruned with Homo by D7), Batrachia (minimum 245 Ma), Caudata (minimum 150.8 Ma) and twelve internal minima. None is on crown Lissamphibia.

prior_form: treePL maximum 515 Ma on the root (hornworts x mosses), no minimum
evidence: Bechteler et al. 2023 treePL configuration, l.17-18: 'mrca = ROOT ...Leiosporoceros_dussii ...Neckera_crispa' and 'max = ROOT 515'. Every bootstrap tree sits on that maximum (the interval is degenerate, D22).

prior_form: offset Gamma on the root (all 81 taxa): offset 236, shape 2, scale 3 (BEAST2 ShapeScale); specified 2.5/97.5% quantiles 236.73/252.71 Ma
evidence: root.prior MRCAPrior over all 81 taxa, l.779-866 (Gamma.41 offset=236.0 alpha=2.0 beta=3.0). Effective prior: the same XML with sampleFromPrior=true on the MCMC element (raw/revision-2026-10/cephalopods/prior_run/), BEAST 2.7.7 with bModelTest 1.3.3, ORC 1.2.1, BEASTLabs 2.0.3, seed 20261007; equal-tailed 95% interval of Tree.height after 10% burn-in. Run stopped at state 21,459,000 of 30,000,000 (7,154 logged samples, 6,439 after burn-in); effective prior median 240.5734 Ma against the posterior median 240.0408 Ma. Reproduce: python scripts/crown_intervals.py --prior-log Data/raw/revision-2026-10/cephalopods/prior_run/phylogeny_BEAUti_nov28_sampleFromPrior.log

Vaga et al. 2025 response to referees, l.275-304: five calibration points all younger than 127 Ma plus one older point (Caryophyllia, 160 Ma); none on crown Scleractinia. The authors ran BEAST sampling from the prior and report that prior and posterior differ.

prior_form: treePL hard bounds 190-302 Ma on the diatom MRCA
evidence: Nakov et al. 2018 treePL configuration, l.27-29: 'mrca = diatomMRCA corethron_criophilum campylodiscus_hibernicus_lo17', 'min = diatomMRCA 190', 'max = diatomMRCA 302'. The median sits on the 190 Ma minimum (at_bound, D22).

prior_form: crown Echinodermata: older (maximum) bound 515.5 Ma, younger bound unconstrained
evidence: Mongiardino Koch et al. 2022 eLife 11:e72460, calibration appendix: 'Echinodermata (Pelmatozoan-Eleutherozoan divergence) - Younger bound: Unconstrained. Older bound: 515.5 Ma'. The reported interval 498.8-525.0 Ma straddles that maximum; the root (Ambulacraria, 518-636.1 Ma) is pruned by D7.

prior_form: minimum-only soft bounds on nodes A-E (231, 505, 475, 530, 418 Ma) and a soft maximum of 550 Ma on the root (Mollusca, pruned by D7)
evidence: Zapata et al. 2014 Proc. R. Soc. B 281:20141739, Methods and figure 4 legend: fossil minima on nodes A-E with 2.5% left tail, root maximum 550 Ma. Every calibration that could sit on crown Gastropoda is a minimum; whether node E (Sublitoidea, 418 Ma) is the crown was not checked, and a one-sided bound does not enter the D25 test either way.

prior_form: NDexp: exponential prior offset to the 164.9 Ma minimum with its 95% quantile at the 201.5 Ma maximum (mean 36.6/-ln 0.05 = 12.217 Myr); 2.5% quantile 164.9 + 12.217 x -ln(0.975) = 165.209 Ma
evidence: Upham et al. 2019 PLoS Biol. 17:e3000494, S1 Text section 6.1, calibration 1: 'Mammalia: 164.9 Ma minimum age to 201.5 Ma maximum age'; main text: NDexp priors 'offset to minimum ages with soft maxima so that the upper 95% of the distribution equaled maximum ages'. The root (Amniota) is uniform 318.0-332.9 Ma and is pruned by D7.

prior_form: soft bounds 515-541 Ma on the root (DM_Igernella_notabilis x DM_Geodia_neptuni), PhyloBayes -sb; root prior gamma mean 540, sd 540 (-rp 540 540)
evidence: Lavrov et al. 2023 calibration file: 'DM_Igernella_notabilis DM_Geodia_neptuni.mf 541 515'; job script 4-Molecular-clock_submission-scripts_clock2.job: pb ... -cal calib -sb -rp 540 540. The calibrated MRCA (Keratosa x Heteroscleromorpha) is the root of the all-Demospongiae tree.

Tonini et al. 2016 place their calibrations in Squamata_Tree_Methods_Data.zip on Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.db005, which returned HTTP 401 (API) and a challenge page (file stream); the Dryad landing metadata names the file but not the calibrations. Whether crown Squamata carries a two-sided calibration is not checked, so by D25 the interval is not excluded; recorded 2026-10-08.

prior_form: 22 uniform priors of Joyce et al. 2013 (J. Paleontol. 87:612-634), MrBayes
evidence: Thomson et al. 2021 PNAS Methods: '22 uniform fossil calibration priors that have been previously defined and justified (4)'. Joyce et al. 2013 is paywalled and was not obtained, so whether crown Testudines carries one is not checked. MrBayes uniform priors are hard bounds, so any uniform prior on this node spans at least the reported 185.4-239.5 Ma.
